summary: The storage chart's backup-server Service now carries the prometheus.io scrape annotations for pod port 8081 (/metrics), and the pod declares a metrics containerPort. The Service ports and the nginx target-port stay on 8080. The orphaned backup-server-tokens ConfigMap is gone from the dev storage release, and deleting the live dev object is close-out A1. A hermetic test covers both; kc project test is green (HelmCharts 3419695 on phase/023-P3).
